programmes.d: When Russia's first nuclear submarine malfunctions on its maiden voyage, the crew must race to save the ship and prevent a nuclear disaster.
An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.
A U.S. Customs official uncovers a money laundering scheme involving Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar.
A teenage girl discovers a box that carries magic powers and a deadly price for using them.
